summary:
Being the newest standard iPad doesn't protect it from a school-run tumble. We've already seen 2025 iPad 11th gen models come in with cracked glass barely out of the box.

The good news is that glass-only repair is available on this model, which usually costs less than a full screen. If the USB-C port is damaged, we repair it with micro-soldering and keep your data in place. That typically costs R1,000 to R1,500.

Visit our workshop at Silvercrest Shopping Centre or book R300 collection anywhere in Gauteng. Free diagnostic and a 6-month warranty on every repair.

Tap Call now to speak to us about your repair.
